audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating 7.5/10 against a 54.27% Gangplank win rate over 750 games.
audit.why: Gangplank is clearly favoured across the game; the difficulty is a short, sharp levels 1-3 problem, not a hard lane.
audit.corrected: Difficulty 5/10, Pantheon carry threat 6/10 — he has no item scaling and falls off after 6, which the prose already says.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Pantheon both item stages and 'Skill' at level 1, contradicting whys[0] ('every short trade goes to him'), whys[3] ('Your Sheen/Essence Reaver spike flips the lane') and whys[5] ('chained keg detonations one-shot his squishy frame').
audit.why: Pantheon owns 1-3 outright and Gangplank owns everything from first item on; the packet chart agrees.
audit.corrected: One group: L1 Pantheon 3/10, L2 Pantheon 3/10, L3 Pantheon 4/10, L4-5 Skill 5/10, L6 Gangplank 6/10, First item Gangplank 8/10, 2+ items Gangplank 9/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault is called Pantheon's passive in four places. It is his E — an 80-mana, 22/21/20/19/18 channel. His actual passive is Mortal Will. Shield Vault's auto-attack reset is also never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot text: E 'Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear'; passive is 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' Calling a 22-second directional channel a passive tells the player it is always on and that there is nothing to play around — the opposite of the truth. Walking around it and waiting out 22s is the counterplay. Shield Vault carries the autoReset flag, so his attack wind-up is the tell, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Aegis Assault labelled (E) with its 22s cooldown and front-only blocking in all four places; Shield Vault given 13s and its auto-reset tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield Vault, the ability the entire entry says to track, never had a cooldown attached to it.
audit.why: 13/12/11/10/9 is the window; the mirror audit reached the same conclusion about stating the real numbers.
audit.corrected: 13s at rank 1 in the cooldown breakdown, do's and interactions report.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 belong to Pantheon and you have to respect it. His Comet Spear (Q) out-pokes you, his Aegis Assault passive periodically blocks your Parrrley (Q) and basic attacks from the front so AA trades go to him, and your single Powder Keg (E) has a long cooldown and low HP he can free-hit to deny your zoning. Do not step up into Q range to last-hit with autos; secure the cannon and caster minions with Parrrley from max distance, and hold Remove Scurvy (W) to cleanse his Shield Vault (W) stun and heal the chip if he commits a gap-close all-in. Eat a little poke, farm safe, and survive to your stabilizing levels.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 belong to Pantheon and you have to respect it. His Comet Spear (Q) out-pokes you, Aegis Assault (E, 22s) blocks your Parrrley and basic attacks from the front for the whole channel, and your single Powder Keg (E) has a long cooldown and low HP he can free-hit to deny your zoning. Do not step up into Q range to last-hit with autos; secure the cannon and casters with Parrrley from max distance, and hold Remove Scurvy (W) to cleanse his Shield Vault stun and heal the chip. Shield Vault is an auto reset, so his attack wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to step back.

notes: Aegis Assault was labelled Pantheon's passive in four places — it is his E, a 22-second directional channel, and treating it as an always-on passive removes the whole counterplay (walk around it, wait it out). His real passive is Mortal Will. The packet flagged 'His Comet Spear' and 'His Shield Vault' as suspect names; both are false positives.
